comment: Upstream provenance for every OpenChamber patch in the queue. `relationship` says what an upstream release would mean for this patch: same (we shipped this change, or upstream did), alternative (upstream shipped a different design for the same need, so the patch needs reconciling rather than porting), partial (upstream took part of it), pending (a PR or issue is open and nothing has shipped), none (local only, no upstream counterpart). `mergedAs` is the merge commit when one exists. `intent` says what the patch deserves upstream: bugfix (a broken thing upstream owns), feature, personal (stays local), testing (wants more use before deciding) or declined (the maintainer refused it). `since` is the date this record was last checked. Update this file whenever a patch is added, dropped or re-expressed; scripts/openchamber-upstream.sh fails when a queued patch has no record here.

commandcode-quota.note: Local-only provider. Upstream removed Command Code quota in 1.21.0 (its official API exposes no usage data) and declined to restore it; this reads the web app's own billing routes with a browser session token. Ported onto main's TypeScript provider module.

question-indicator.note: Feature awaiting acceptance. Draws the permission shield and question mark through one shared component with its own question colour role, and builds only on top of stale-pending-badge.

stale-pending-badge.note: Behaviour only: a session row's badge answers from the directory store once it has read its own requests, and from the cross-directory index before that, so a lost settlement stops showing and a never-opened folder still shows what waits. Ported onto main's split sync modules and timeline hook. Draft PR #6804; posts on Jeremy's word.

reply-start-scroll.note: Feature request open. The pill's up arrow walks back to the nearest reply whose prose starts above the viewport, past the tool rows that led to it. Ported onto main's timeline handle: useNavigationSettle gained a measurement re-arm and a through-list scroll, and TimelineList/useMessageListHandle own the new handle methods.

draft-heading-project-picker.note: The project's name in a new-session heading is a second way into the composer's project picker. Local only; no upstream request. Ported onto main's ComposerDraftTitle and DraftWelcome: the request travels through a store because the welcome renders the heading in another component.

recap-full-note.note: A UI preference: the recap ends the transcript instead of lying over the gap above the composer, so the whole note stays readable. Stays local. Ported onto main's ChatViewport listFooter.

image-viewer-zoom.note: Pinch, double-tap and wheel zoom with pan for the image viewer, on top of upstream's fit levels. Ported onto main's imageZoom module and ToolOutputDialog.

mobile-assist-trigger.note: Android assist and deep-link launch: the launch intent is rewritten before the bridge reads it, and an assist tap opens a new draft. Local: no upstream request.

mobile-voice-launch.note: openchamber://new-session?dictate=1 starts dictation in the draft it names, bound to the draft's id so it never records in another. Ported onto main's composer hooks: the request is consumed in ChatInput, not in the old monolith.

dictation-recovery.note: A dictation transcript stays with the composer it was started in: a session or draft switch while it is being transcribed no longer inserts it into whatever is on screen. Origin is keyed by the composer's stable key; the transcript is stored in the origin's draft. Local.

instance-attention.note: Cross-instance attention: desktop and mobile poll the saved hosts and the app's own server and show one merged, ordered list of sessions that need the user. 69 files, mostly new modules; local only.

question-rows.note: A question call becomes its own row in the transcript instead of a tool row: answered ones stick under their prompt and end its sticky span, waiting ones read as a card. Ported onto main's timeline: the row is cut in timelineRows.ts, the sticky rules live in stickyPrompt.ts, and the card is the row's body so the turn footer and a stopped turn's failure text stay.

question-cards.note: The card itself: every option with the chosen one marked, a typed answer as one more row, a pinned batch collapsing to a one-line bar of answers, and a working turn's fold preview drawing the card in step order. Ported onto main's body modules (useAssistantRenderedParts) and TurnRow.

in-work-paging.note: In work ranks its rows by what needs the user (a waiting answer, then a running turn, then unread or looks-done) from the live turn and request indexes only, so a recency update does not re-run it. Local.

hide-empty-worktrees.note: A worktree nobody has used yet (no session, no draft, no pin, no archived session) can be left out of the sidebar. A search still finds it. Local: the setting is ours.

gitea-references-across.note: The reference picker's search across a folder's repositories for Gitea and Forgejo, which have no API that names a set of repositories: a page is read per folder and merged by activity. 48 files. Ported onto main's provider-resource contract (referencesAcross in the descriptor, provider and routes) and its TypeScript settings/client modules.

android-notification-dismiss.note: Opening a session removes its own delivered phone banners, and the subagent banners under it. Merged locally after the v2.7.2 port retired it on a wrong "upstream has it" reading; still open upstream.

notification-family-clear.note: Local first again: the first attempt (PR #7232, closed) generalised the shared ancestor walk and regressed ready-push suppression for a running subagent of a workflow agent. This one leaves `session-activity.js` alone, clears the viewed session exactly as before, and walks only the open-tag sessions with each candidate failing on its own, a cap of 50 sessions/8 steps/5 s, and a snapshot check so a tag re-claimed during the walk keeps its banner. Issue #7229 is still open; upstream work waits until it has had a few days of local use.

chat-width-80.note: A fourth chat width, Extra wide (80rem), between Wider and Full. Upstream owns the setting now (default/wider/full, migrated in v29); this re-expresses the 80rem level on top of it rather than porting our old ladder.

in-work-paging-show-more.note: In work opens with its own page size (a stored per-surface number) and Show more adds the same number again, separate from the sidebar's session batch size. Local.

mobile-guest-catalog-failure.note: Reproduced on v2.7.2 with a corrupt extensions.json: the phone now says the extension catalog could not be read instead of showing an empty list. Ported onto main's guests store.

changed-file-chip-opens-file-outside-git.note: A changed-file chip naming a file no repository lists opens the file itself instead of an empty diff list; a deleted file opens the editor's not-found state. Ported onto main's diffView turn-navigation hook.

question-recorded-answers.note: The expanded tool row reads the answers the question call recorded, including a multi-select pick that carries the recommendation marker. Upstream has a PR for the quote case (an expanded row cutting an answer at its first double quote); questionEntries.ts is ours. If #7109 merges, ours leaves the queue at the next bump.

attention-folder-filter.note: Follow-up to instance-attention, local only: the attention drawer applied the sidebar's folder rule to this instance's sessions only, so a saved server's sessions in folders it never registered appeared once the window switched to it. Both halves read one rule now, and a host that cannot answer keeps its rows.

attention-local-load.note: Follow-up to instance-attention, local only: a host switch clears the global session list and the phone mounts no poller, so the instance on screen published no rows until the sessions sheet was opened, and the drawer read as one host having more waiting work than it does.

candidates.name: chat-small-image-upscale
candidates.note: The chat's tool-output dialog draws a picture larger than its own pixels at fit: a 64x64 icon renders near 1055%, where the files preview never upscales. No local patch yet.
